svg.text: 3D CAD Model 8 (Long-Range Pod Cutaway): Single-Prop, 2× Recessed Struts & V-Cradle Wing
Translucent pod shows twin G10 bulkheads, central 120° V-cradle breakaway socket (2× corner pins + leash) & 10" CNC prop
Houses 5.38 kWh dry EVE LF105 (100% flush top!)
260 mm T-heads + 180 mm pod saddles + line cutter!
2× Ø8 mm corner pins pop BOTH halves + 0.35 m leash!
Continuous or 2-half carrier block • -30% induced drag
Rear Strut Drafts in Front Wake
Twin 6 mm G10 internal bulkheads take roll & yaw!
Direct-drive shaft seal — zero deck boxes!
78–80% prop eff. • Saves ~32 Wh/nm vs twin pods!
Interactive 3D STL: models/08_lr_pod_closeup.stl (Long-Range Hydro Package internal cutaway)
